Attached: 1 image

ServiceNow's product security team covers roughly 90 container release programs (80 internal apps, 10 hosted for customers, all on Kubernetes) for about 600 developers.

Every containerized product now gets scanned, SBOMs and policy results flow into their own systems of record via API, and security review moved earlier in the pipeline.

Write-up: https://anchore.com/blog/servicenow-container-release-sbom-driven-security/

#SBOM #Kubernetes #DevSecOps
